t: Kill 12 Primal Muskir and return to Liho the Nomadic.

The Kingdom of Nature should belong only to us - the Orcs! I don't suppose you have any objections to that, right?
Good, then together we can drive the others out of here.
Your first goal should be to eliminate those muskir. The druids and the animists prey on the creatures and use their spores to make Refreshing Potions. If there are no more muskir in the woods, then the League wardens will not have that tool in their arsenal. Then we'll have the edge and be able to destroy them! It's brilliant, isn't it?
Go out into the Shadowy Mire and destroy as many as you can. And remember to kill any druids or animists that you meet too!
To think that the filthy League is allowed in here. It's an abomination! Who taught them the secret of how to get here, anyway?
Excellent. The fewer the muskir, the worse off the League will be. Haha!
Collect 12 Violet Dogberries from Sunscatter Forest and bring them to Liho the Nomadic.

The League uses dogberries to make their Lethargy Potions. I'm sure the potions are weak from using such an impractical reagent, but nonetheless the League must be stopped from making them. Then they won't be able to quell our range with those annoying concoctions.
Follow the road to the west, past the Shadowy Mire, and into Sunscatter Forest. There you shall find many of the dogberry bushes. Pick a few handfuls and return them to me, so that I may dispose of the things properly. And of course, remember to kill any of the League you run into.
The druids and animists are a disgrace to the wardens. To think that they use such pathetic reagents. Pah!
Give me those berries. I need to throw them into the fire immediately. Burn, burn!
Kill 8 Primal Gray Wolves and return to Ziva the Nomadic.

Now, I ask you to hunt out of duty. Lately the gray wolves around here have grown too brazen. They attack the young shamans when they go out to gather crow eyes, and we must protect our comrades. This shall be a more difficult task, but that will make it all the more enjoyable!
Go to the north of here, where most of the gray wolves roam. It should be easy to pick up their trace for they are many around there. When you return from the hunt, I expect at least eight gray wolves to lay lifeless.
The teeth of beasts are dangerous, but the most dangerous thing of all is indecision.
Thank you for your help. Maybe soon I will call on you for greater tasks.
Kill 4 League wardens are return to Liho the Nomadic.

The time has come to give you the most important job yet. Now, the best way to defeat an enemy is to kill him, right? Right. That means it's time to stop wasting time and get right to it.
Yes, sabotaging the enemy is all good and well, and I encourage you to keep those things up. But we need to make them afraid to step outside their camp! We need to make them realize that they should leave the Kingdom of Nature entirely! Then we will have this area all to ourselves. Ha!
I would say that four should be enough for today. Little by little, we will destroy their morale. Return to me when they are dead.
I dream of the day when we can wander this kingdom without interference.
Good job! We are one step closer to domination!
Kill 10 Primal Boars and return to Ziva the Nomadic.

Part of becoming one with nature is to learn to hunt, as most beasts do.
Real shamans need to learn how to stalk their prey, descend upon them quickly, and most of all - enjoy the rush of the kill!
Lucky for you, the Kingdom of Nature is one of the best places to hunt! It's filled with all sorts of wild beasts. I suggest you start your training with the boars around here. They can be found near the border to the Shadowy Mire. What are you waiting for, do your veins flow with fire or not? Can't you feel your heart beating faster when you think about the hunt? Then get going!
Many say that I have become too bloodthirsty, but I know that the essence of a shaman's nature is to hunt!
Good job. Those boars aren't the hardest things to kill, but it's a good start.
Kill 10 Primal Boars and return to Bogdan Kochakov.

I know I have already asked you to help the Kingdom, but it seems I must ask again. Farther into the woods are more boars, but these are tainted by the poison that spreads from the swamp. They are wild and wicked, and attack any who pass by. They also dig out the roots of trees, as if they are intent on destroying the forest.
I would have never thought that nature could produce such creatures. But then again, there are the Orcs... I suppose there are many creatures whose purpose for existence is a mystery... Anyway, let's stop talking about those horrible shamans and get back to the task at hand.
I beg you, go to the eastern edge of the forest and slay as many of the vicious boars as you can. Return to me when the task is complete, and I shall be eternally grateful.
Boars were used by the Orcs as pets at one point in time. Under the Orcs' command, they were almost as vile as the tainted ones in this forest.
Forgive us mother nature for the blood that has been spilt today. It is not for the sake of death, but for the sake of life!
Kill 12 Primal Toads and return to the Leafy Family.

I assume that you're here to gather berries, spring water, and other ingredients. Am I right? While that's good, you should also do something to help out all of the League wardens while you're here! Imagine what the benefits would be if all of the Orcish shamans were driven from the Kingdom. And I think I have a plan to help us do this.
You see, the Orcs come here for the same reasons we do - to gather reagents for potions. If we could prevent them from doing this, they might stop coming! And even if they don't, without those potions they'll be much weaker. Then we can beat them up really easily.
Let's start off with the toads. They live all over the Shadowy Mire and the Orcs use their mucus to make Refreshing Potions. If there's no toads, there's no slime, so go in there and start killing the beasts!
We will always remember how the Orcs started attacking Gibberling settlements hundreds of years ago. They will never be forgiven!
Good, good. The fewer the toads, the weaker the shamans will be and huntmasters.
Collect 12 Glinting Crow Eyes from the Primal Crows and bring them to the Leafy Family.

Now it is time to continue the war with the shamans. We must stop them from gathering another one of their reagents! To create Lethargy Potions they use the eyes of the crows that roam the Kingdom. We must take them for ourselves, even if it means murdering the poor beasts! In the end the peace it will bring will be worth it.
Follow the road to the east until you reach the lands where the snow falls. There the crows roam freely. Kill many of them, and remember to pry out their eyes after they are dead. Then bring them to me and I shall dispose of the filthy things. I am sure that without half of their potions, the shamans will soon fall!
We have a very good reason to hate those Orcs and Xadaganians. They are the ancestral enemies of both Gibberlings and wardens!
Give me those crow eyes! Now to crush them under our heels, just as we will the shamans. Ha!
Kill 8 Primal Black Wolves and return to Bogdan Kochakov.

I have another task for you. This time we must protect the young druids and animists. If you could offer your assistance once again, I would be very grateful.
To the south of here, among the dense Dogberry thickets, there are many black wolves. Lately young and inexperienced wardens who go to collect the berries have become their prey. While it is our duty to respect all living creatures, this does not mean we should turn a blind eye to the deaths of our friends! They must be taught to leave the wardens alone.
Once druids kept wolves as their pets, but this was stopped because rage will always live in the beasts' hearts!
There is room for all in the Kingdom, even terrible creatures like wolves. The main thing is that you need to keep the upper hand.
Kill 4 Imperial wardens are return to the Leafy Family.

Now you need to begin the most complex part of our plan. If all goes as expected, we will soon control the Kingdom of Nature.
Your task is to directly attack the shamans. Destroy any that dare leave their camp. Make sure that these forests are cleansed of their presence. Prove that we druids and animists are the true masters of this land! You will face many hardships, but remember how important this job is. Now go out and return to me when some of them lie dead.
The shamans are horrible creatures! Kill them without remorse!
Good job! We'll show them that we're the kings of this kingdom!
Kill 10 Primal Boars and return to Bogdan Kochakov.

My name is Bogdan Kochakov, and I come from an ancient line of druids. Our original homeland was consumed by the Astral, but since then we have lived here. We have taken it upon ourselves to make sure that this place remains an idyllic haven for druids and animists alike, and I would now ask that you help me with this task.
Sunscatter Forest spreads to the east, and it is filled with many different creatures. Among them are boars, and recently their numbers have increased beyond what they should be. It is our duty to get rid of some, for one must weed the garden so that other flowers may grow. Return to me when you have finished.
If the boars continue to root around in the earth, the plants will die and this Kingdom will crumble.
Thank you. Do not forget to visit the stream and wash your hands of blood.
Hello novice! What do you want?
Speak to Durha the Nomadic to receive 5 Essences of Fury.

Aha! I can see you've recovered the secret of the Potion of Punishment!
And you surely want to learn how to make it?
Huh, you are not ready yet to hunt wolves, whose fangs serve as a basic ingredient for the Essence of Fury. That's why I'll be giving you 5 flasks of the Essence every day. For free.
But it won't last forever. As soon as you grow up and gain level 20, it will be over. So, be my guest. For the time being.

Here, take it!
I'm in good mood today!

h: Exchange Vials of Thickened Blood for Aqua Vitae
Exchange Glinting Crow Eyes for Lethargy Potions
Exchange Toad Mucus for Refreshing Potions
Exchange Beast Hearts for Aqua Morte
Trade the Wolf Fang for the Essence of Fury

t: Hello there! How can I help you?
Bring 12 Vials of Thickened Blood to Durha the Nomadic.

Listen up, cause I'm only going to give this spiel once. The location of this allod is completely unknown. It probably floats somewhere deep in the Astral, but who knows - maybe it's in another world altogether. Even after setting up beacons along the shore for Imperial ships, no one could find this place. That means the only way to get here is through a special portal, and only wardens are taught how to access it.
That's perfect for us, because this area is full of ingredients that we can use to make special potions. Now no one can disturb our business or destroy our resources. The way it's gonna work is you bring me the ingredients and I'll make the appropriate extracts. You can then turn those into potions.
I'm gonna make this first one easy on you. You see those buckets? They contain animal blood that's been left out to thicken. Bring me some vials and I'll give you some Lifeforce Essence that you can use to make Aqua Vitae.
Those druids and animists use water to make their Aqua Vitae. Can you believe it? What idiots! No wonder they're so weak.
Good job. Here you go, twelve Lifeforce Essences. You'd be best to keep Aqua Vitae on you at all times.
Bring 12 Glinting Crow Eyes to Durha the Nomadic.

You should be learning to create Lethargy Potions soon. That means you're going to need some Dream Essences. I can create those for you of course, but you have to bring me the proper ingredients first.
What I need are some good quality crow eyes. Fortunately, there's a whole bunch of crows flying right along the borders of our camp. They're pretty docile creatures, so it shouldn't take you long to kill a bunch of them.
Hurry up and bring me their eyes. And don't worry, Nature is a generous mother! No matter how many crows I strangle, there are always more being born. Ha!
The druids and animists use berries instead of crow eyes. They claim that they don't want to disrupt the natural balance by killing creatures! What an obvious excuse to hide their cowardice.
Great! Just give me the eyes and you'll get some Dream Essence.
Collect 12 portions of Toad Mucus and return to Durha the Nomadic.

Refreshing Potions are extremely important to a shaman. Sometimes enemies can be pretty tough. At times like those you just need to run away and recover before you can get you back in the game, you know?
In order to cook up a Refreshing Potion, you're going to need some Vigor Essences. And those I can extract from toad mucus! The mucus can be gathered from the huge green toads that live in the swamp to the west.
Just be careful out there, the beasts are fairly strong. And make sure you don't get close to Fangourne! He'll take you out pretty quickly.
The cowardly League wardens are afraid of the toads. That's why they kill the flimsy muskir for reagents to make their Refreshing Potions.
Ah yes, this mucus is good and thick. Give it here and I'll extract some powerful Vigor Essences.
Collect 12 Beast Hearts from the creatures in Sunscatter Forest and return to Durha the Nomadic.

Now it is time to teach you how to prepare Aqua Morte. Listen closely to my words, for it is a very powerful potion.
There is a special bond between a warden and their pet. When their companions die, the wardens mourn deeply. It is for this reason that their hearts make wonderful reagents - they are filled with the grief of the warden. It is from these hearts that I can make Nightmare Essence.
No, I'm not going to make you kill our pets. Stop being ridiculous! Fortunately, this Kingdom is filled with the pets of the League. Go to Sunscatter Forests and kill the squirrels, lynx, and bears. Gather a dozen of their hearts and bring them back to me.
Did you know where the druids and animists get the hearts for their potions? That's right! They kill our goblins. Those bastards!
These are excellent hearts - full of blood and veins. Now let me make you that Nightmare Essence.
Collect 12 Wolf Fangs and return to Durha the Nomadic.

Now you can fight wolves and collect their fangs, the reagent for the Essence of Fury.
Go to Shadowy Mire or Sunscatter Forest. Evil wolves dwell there. After you kill them, don't forget to open their jaws and take the fangs out.
As soon as you have 12, come back and I will prepare the Essence for you!

Druids and Animists also hunt wolves for their fangs.
I hope you won't give them a chance to rob us!
Bring 12 Bottles of Enchanted Water to Lada Berezova.

Welcome to the Kingdom of Nature! This is truly a wonderful and mysterious place! no one knows exactly where it's located, although we guess that it's floating somewhere in the far Astral. Who or what keeps it from being destroyed is completely unknown. The only way to get here is by accessing a special portal, and that secret is passed down from warden to warden.
We were granted this Kingdom, and it would be wrong not to use its gifts. It is full of powerful ingredients that can be used to make special potions. First the proper essences need to be extracted from them, but if you bring them to me I would be happy to do that for you.
You should probably start by gathering enchanted water. If you go north of here there is a waterfall, and the clearest water you've ever seen flows freely from it. From that I can extract Lifeforce Essences, for water is the basis of all life. You can then use those to make Aqua Vitae.
Imperial shamans and huntmasters use blood to create Lifeforce Essences, but true wardens use pure and innocent ingredients in their rituals.

Perfect.
Now you can have these twelve Lifeforce Essences to make some Aqua Vitae.
Bring 12 Violet Dogberries to Lada Berezova.

Soon you should learn the secret of making Lethargy Potions. To make it you will need Dream Essences, and those I can extract for you if you bring me the proper ingredients.
What I need are dogberries. You see, we druids and animists always seek to use the natural strengths of Nature's creations. The juice of these berries normally induces a state of drowsiness and weakness, and the essence I can extract from them is even more potent. Here in the Kingdom, violet dogberry bushes grow throughout the Sunscatter Forest. Bring them to me and I will make the essences you need.
Can you believe that shamans and huntmasters use crow eyes instead of dogberries? What abominations!
Here are the Dream Essences, as promised. Use them well.
Collect 12 Muskir Spores and return to Lada Berezova.

In order to make Vigor Essences I need the spores of the muskir that live near the swamp. They are vicious creatures, heavily tainted by the darkness that spreads from the heart of that area.
To make it worse, the place is usually full of shamans. You'll need to watch your back at all times when you're there. And make sure to watch out for Fangourne - he's an extremely powerful treant.
The trouble should be worth it, though. The Refreshing Potions that you can make from the essences are some of our most powerful concoctions. Return to me when you have gathered a few handfuls.
The shamans use toad mucus to make Vigor Essences. Why would they use such disgusting things? I have no idea.
And now these twelve spores will be turned into twelve essences! Here you go!
Collect 12 Goblin Hearts from the goblins in the Frostpaw Hills and return to Lada Berezova.

With a heavy heart I will now instruct you in your next stage of education. A few years ago, the shamans refused to use animals as their pets. They decided that enslaved goblins would make better companions than wolves, lions, or any of the other beasts they had traditionally used.
There is a magical link between a warden and his pet, even if it's a creature as odd as a goblin. In their hearts is eternal loyalty to their master, and upon the pets' death their hearts fill with grief and sadness at having to part with them. Because of this, we can extract Nightmare Essences from the hearts which can then be used to concoct Aqua Morte.
If you want such hearts, you should hunt the goblins that inhabit Frostpaw Hills. They are all pets of the wardens, and they will supply the necessary reagents. It is a gruesome task, I know, and if you choose not to continue I shall not stop you. But if you find the will to collect the hearts, bring them to me and I will make you Nightmare Essences.
If you encounter any shamans in the forest, remember that they probably ripped out the hearts of our own pets. Let this knowledge spur you to kill them!
I shall now turn these vile things into Nightmare Essences. Through the goblins' deaths, perhaps we can make the tools to defeat the shamans and bring peace to this Kingdom.
Collect 12 Wolf Fangs and bring them to Yaroslav Gusev.

Now if you need the Essence, you have to fight the wolves that inhabit Shadowy Mire and Sunscatter Forest.
Collect 12 Wolf Fangs and bring them to me. I will distill them into the Potion of Punishment.
Remember, Shamans also hunt these wolves for fangs, so be careful!

The Essence of Fury is extracted of these particularly sharp and bloody fangs.
Here!
Speak to Yaroslav Gusev to receive 5 Essences of Fury.

So you got to know the Potion of Punishment and its secrets.
This potion is quite difficult to prepare. Wolves whose fangs serve as the main ingredient for the extract are too strong for you right now.
That's why I'll be giving you 5 flasks of this potion every day. But this is not going to last forever - as soon as you reach level 20, you will have to challenge the wolves yourself.
Still, for now you can use our supplies.

Here is some for today.
Grow up faster and stop being a burden for our community.

h: Exchange Bottles of Enchanted Water for Aqua Vitae
Exchange Violet Dogberries for Lethargy Potions
Exchange Muskir Spores for Refreshing Potions
Exchange Goblin Hearts for Aqua Morte
Trade the Wolf Fang for the Essence of Fury

t: Hello there! How can I help you?
Bring Bikad the Nomadic 4 bottles of Thickened Blood and 4 Glinting Crow Eyes.

Dang it! Chomiak is such a bastard! He ran off to Nezebgrad and left me to do his duties. Now I stand here waiting around for travelers!
You see, one of the shamans is always left to monitor the flow of travelers into this Kingdom. We make sure that only those who are worthy learn the secret of getting here, and we have the power to send shamans back to the main allods.
Chomiak is supposed to be the guardian at the moment, but nobody knows where he ran off to. Slacker! Oh well, I guess it can't be helped...
As long as I'm stuck in this camp, you can help me out. I need to restock on Refreshing Potions and Lethargy Potions, but I can't gather the materials myself. Bring me four bottles of thickened blood and four crow eyes. Otherwise my services are off limit to you!
Where can you find the stuff? The blood is in buckets around the camp, and the eyes can be found on the crows nearby. Now get going!
Hm... I wonder if this will be any good for potion making... maybe if I knock the hamster around a bit more... What? Oh! Nothing.
Great job! These are perfect. Now I can send you back to the place from which you teleported here, or to the place where you are bound. May you be victorious in all your battles!
Bring Lada Berezova 4 Bottles of Enchanted Water and 4 Violet Dogberries.

I am the guardian of this great Kingdom. When my father Ladomir died this role was passed on to me. And if I choose to leave this mysterious Kingdom or die, then someone else will take my place.
You see, we druids decided that a guardian is needed to protect this Kingdom from the greed of mortals. That means that travel to this land is closely monitored. The secret of how to get here is only given to a select few, and only I am able to send wardens away from this Kingdom.
I am happy to help you get back to Novograd, but I do charge a small fee for my services. You see, I need to make Refreshing Potions and Lethargy Potions too, but it's hard to do when I can't leave my post.
Bring me four bottles of enchanted water and four violet dogberries and your acceptance into the Kingdom will be complete. The water can found at the northern waterfall, and the berries can be found on the bushes just south of here.
Sometimes I visit Novograd myself to visit relatives. When I'm away Borea takes over my duties.
Great job! These are perfect. Now I can send you back to the place from which you teleported here, or to the place where you are bound. May you be victorious in all your battles!
Meet with the shamans to learn more about the Kingdom of Nature.
Good morning young shaman! Glad to see you here in the Kingdom of Nature. You should meet with your colleagues to learn more about this great land. Come back to me after you've gotten your bearings.
You should learn about what's going on here as quickly as possible. It's essential to your role as a Shaman.
So, what do you think? Are you ready to go explore on your own?
We have this entire land to ourselves - except for those miserable druids and animists.
h: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t: Meet with the druids to learn more about the Kingdom of Nature.
Hello! Welcome to the Kingdom of nature. You should go meet the other wardens around our camp. They'll teach you more about this marvelous world.
How wonderful it is the first time you behold the Kingdom! I'm a little envious of you.
Done? Now you should go explore for yourself and see how wonderful the land truly is.
This is not just any forest. This is our wonderful forest! Appreciate and take care of it.
h: Ask about the Kingdom of Nature

t: Take the mysterious package from Bob Jackhammer.

Boss, I have a package for you. The messenger who delivered it, there was definitely something strange about him. I can swear I saw smoke rising up from his hood!
He shoved me the parcel and muttered that he'd be back next week. And he told me to pass it to you immediately, and then he just disappeared, I swear!
So I have no idea who the sender is.
If this messenger show up again the next week, I won't let him go away this easy. I'll ask who he is and what he's up to! Have to keep all my eyes about him, though, or he’ll flee in a wink again!
Take the mysterious package from Bob Jackhammer.

Boss, I have a package for you. The messenger who delivered it, there was definitely something strange about him. I can swear I saw smoke rising up from his hood!
He shoved me the parcel and muttered that he'd be back next week. And he told me to pass it to you immediately, and then he just disappeared, I swear!
So I have no idea who the sender is.
If this messenger show up again the next week, I won't let him go away this easy. I'll ask who he is and what he's up to! Have to keep all my eyes about him, though, or he’ll flee in a wink again!
Take the mysterious package from Bob Jackhammer.

Boss, I have a package for you. The messenger who delivered it, there was definitely something strange to him. I can swear I saw smoke rising up from his hood!

He shoved me the parcel and muttered that he'd be back next week. I just turned away, and he was gone. I have no idea what is it in this package, and where it came from!
If this messenger show up again the next week, I won't let him go away this easy. I'll ask who he is and what he's up to! Have to keep all my eyes about him, though, or he'll flee in a wink again!
Tell Khoor-Tarr about your visit to the Thicket of the Primals and meet Khuus-Margen in the Khuus Camp.

What have you seen in the Thicket? Each young fosterling goes through that ritual of initiation, and everyone sees something different. The Primals like to puzzle young hunters, and sometimes you can't figure out their message without the help of a Trainer. I hope I can help you unravel their message!
Aho! My name is Khuus-Margen the Crafty. What brrings such a young Priden to me?
Complete quests from Procopius Secundus, Estelle de Grandeur, and the Fleck Family at the League Embassy and return to the Nimble Family.

So what do you think of the cinema? Did you like it? Ha! What is so interesting about the moving pictures? Theatre - that's the real art! Our company has performed all over Sarnaut, and believe us when we're saying: there is nothing more exciting than sincere acting of a talented actor!

Remember what we told you about a surprise? So here's the deal: we invite you to take part in the performance! It is interesting to watch a play, but it's thrice more interesting to participate in it!

But first, you need to prepare.

Please, talk to our director, Procopius. And find Estelle, our leading actress - she's being late again! And the Flecks, too - we cannot start without them.
Where is everyone? The performance is about to start!
Great, now all are present. Let's begin!
Trap 4 Will-o'-the-Wisps in the magic can and return to Procopius Vto

Greetings! I am Procopius Secundus, the director of the best theater company in Sarnaut. Our fame spreads over all allods, from Umoir to Kanian Archipelagos. Now we've come here to bring the light of true art to the citizens of Howlem!

But we happen to be in trouble right now... Local stone lizards are so ravenous they have eaten even the glass lamps that were supposed to light the stage! The performance is going to lose half of its charm now.

I've found a way to solve the problem, but I will need help. Local Will-o'-the-Wisps are very bright, and we can use them as a source of light! But I'm too old and slow to run after them... Will you do it for me?

Here, take this can. First exhaust them, and then trap them inside. I think four will do!
Wow, these Will-o'-the-Wisps are so mean! Look how brightly they shine. I hope they didn't hurt you. If we get enough of them, we can illuminate the whole stage!
Obtain 10 Sangribloom Flowers and 6 Chalk Stones near the League Embassy and return to Estelle de Grandeur.

Oh, a real Priden! Do you bite? Can I stroke you? You're so cute!

Howlem is a wonderful place! The sunsets are so beautiful here, and the air is so fresh! I feel like I'm a hundred years younger, haha. Travelling in a ship's cargo hold is bad for my skin. Look how pale my wings are.

But your allod is so marvelous, I feel elated both physically and morally. But how can you live without beauty parlors? Not a single barber or a perfumer on the whole allod! No place to buy rouge or lipstick! What a savagery.

I have no other option but to use chalk as powder, and I guess the sap of those carnivorous flowers that prowl around the Embassy can serve as rouge... But I'm so scared of them. I'm an actress, not a gardener!
How do you live without alchemy shops? Where do you buy make-up?!

Oh, thank you! It's a shame there's no dressing room here. How am I supposed to put on make-up with all these peasants scurrying around? Go tell the Nimbles that I will be ready soon. The lady is not late, the lady lingers!
Find Elrick Fleck in the forest and bring him to the Fleck Family at the League Embassy.

Oh, everyone must be looking for us? But we can't go - our brother is missing! He found a barrel of beer and got lost...

Can you help us? We will search the camp, and you look for him in the forest.

If you find him, grab him by the ear and bring here! We will give him a good hammering!
Where is that brat?! We've been looking for him for a good hour!

Here you are, you scoundrel! Just look at him - he's drunk as a skunk! But we will bring him to senses soon. We have a bucket of ice and a thick sack... Don't ask us how it works. We promise you, before the performance starts, he will be stone cold sober!
Errr... Are you going to eat me? Hic!

Hey, I'm not lost! I'd never get... Hic! Who's drunk? Me?! No way! I'm just strolling about, smelling the flowers, writing poems...

You see, I just didn't want to go back on my own... I mean, without a company. You are a good company! Please, come with me, I'm scared...
h: Tell Elrick his sisters are looking for him

t: Take away 15 Shiny Beads from the Greedy Crows and return them to Estelle de Grandeur at the League Embassy.

Oh... It was terrible!

I was trying on my dresses and couldn't decide which one was better - the scarlet silk one or the white laced one. They are both so beautiful.

Then I decided to try them with my shiny necklace. But as soon as I took it out of the box, something black and dire fell on me from above and snatched the necklace from my hands and flew away southbound!

I think it was a crow or a magpie, a giant one. It had a huge beak! I got so scared. Can you help me bring my necklace back? I would be very grateful!
I wonder which gloves should I wear - the crimson or the lilac ones? Or maybe no gloves at all? Everyone should see my beautiful manicure!

What rascals! They've tattered the thread... But at least all the beads are here.

Thank you! I will fix the necklace. I'm not only beautiful, but smart, too.
Take part in the play and return to the Nimble Family.

Remember: theater is your second life! And life is a funny and unpredictable thing. Don't try to act too hard - you don't know the scenario anyway, haha. We'll see how good you are at improvising! How sharp your tongue is?

Alright, here is a short summary: that overdressed Elven couple are passionate lovers. And you are the lady's guardian, who is supposed to protect her from swindlers like that one. But the thing is, you are Estelle's best friend and advisor! You only mean her well, so you help them keep their relationship in secret.

You got it? So go and take the audience by storm, haha! Take this flask. You will need it. No, I'm not giving you any more clues!
Come on, come on! Stage fright is a normal thing for a newbie.

Oops! We're off the scenario! But that's good. That's wonderful! It's not everyday when a tragedy turns into a thriller, haha. But I think that suicidal inclinations of the winged people were not appreciated by the Pridens. I can see why! You struggle to survive here, and elves just squander their lives away. Their centuries-long lives! Phew!

But we have no idea how did the Elemental end up in the flask. We swear! It was some Imperial scheming, most likely.
Go to the Residence and speak to Laan-Ingir the Gray.

We are not taking any more of your time! You probably have to go and do your Priden stuff. Call on us from time to time! Who knows, maybe you'll join our company one day... You are a talented actor, haha!

Meanwhile, we will think of how to get back at the Empire! No killing, of course. But our plan will be devious...

Some old Priden was looking for you, by the way. We heard someone calling him the Gray. You probably know who that was.

Aho, the Enlightened! As I can see, you didn't like the company of the furry strangers? Once our peoples used to share land and food! Only few ones know that. And I suggest you keep it in secret!

Are you wondering why I call you the Enlightened? Huh... Well, listen.
Meet Khuus-Margen at the Khuus Camp.

So, you are the Enlightened, too? You are incredibly lucky! Or not. It depends on the viewpoint. The gift of Light is a great responsibility!

See those two irritated outlanders, zoor? Strrangely enough, they possess the gift, too. Their people have received the gift before us. Why don't you ask them about it?
Wait! I've never seen prriests fight before!

Aho! Why would you interrupt such an interesting discussion? Do you want me to tell you about the Light, after all?

Then listen. The people of the League and the Empire have been enjoying this gift for a longer time than we have, but they've been wasting it unwisely. Almost all humans, orcs, elves, and gibberlings are Enlightened. Even those Arisen weirdoes, who's been dead for long moons. They don't understand that resurrecting makes you weaker. They arrgue over trifles and even kill each other for them! Ay-hya! How does it matter who gives you the Light - Tensess, Nezeb, Skrakan, or the Primals? Only the purrpose of that gift matters, eysh!

The Enlightened must have a purpose, a great purrpose that will keep their tya from resurrection. Pointless resurrection weakens tya, and makes the Enlightened vice and arrogant. Do you have a purpose yet?
Step back! We have some ideological disagreements here! Either this Kanian drunkard will accept the truth, or I will break his jaw!

characters: Parishioner of the Church of Light

t: Obtain 10 measures of Luminescent Dust from Will-o'-the-Wisps and meet Khuus-Margen near the bone totem by the coast.

The gift of the Light is powerful. It will brring you back to life if you die... But you still should trry not to!

The tailless outlanders have told us about their Patrons. Their power helps the Enlightened heal their wounds and fight their enemies. You will see for yourself.

The ritual is simple, but you will need some Luminescent Dust for it. There are plenty of annoying Will-o'-the-Wisps outside the camp, from which you can obtain that dust. Once you finished, meet me by the totem on the coast. Hurry up!
Have you obtained the dust? Don't forget that it doesn't prreserve its light for a long time!
Grreat! Now listen closely, I will not say it again.
Kill 10 rats near the Khuus Camp and report to Khuus-Margen.

Will you do me a favor, eysh?

The ships of the outlanders have brrought unbeknown parasites to our land! They are called rats. They make me regret our hospitality! Ay-hya, if I'd known about them before, I would have killed all the outlanders rright on the berth!

Those rrats eat everything. Tallow drippings for hardening blades, leather braids for handles, bow strings, arrows... One of them gnawed rright through the forge bellows while I was using them, eysh! I don't have time to chase them, so if you kill some ten of them, I will be very grrateful.
Little bastards are dead? Excellent! Thank you, eysh!
Disperse the Luminescent Dust at the Astral Coast, defeat the demon, and gain the first Patronage ability. Return to Khuus-Margen.

The tailless strrangers have told us that on the day of the Great Disaster a dozen of Great Mages died trrying to save their people. Bless those bravehearts, eysh! They say, their tyarra was so strong that it didn't melt after separating with tyalla, but dissolved in the Great Nothing. And those twelve wizards help the Enlightened!

To earn their favor, you need to call upon them at the coast. The Luminescent Dust will make them sense your appeal. But be careful, dangerous monsters of the Great Nothing can also hear you!
Come on, eysh! Disperse the lights on the coast!

Perrfect! The Patron has replied to your call, and now you can benefit from his favor. Appealing to your Patron grants you the ability to heal your most severe wounds. Your gift will help you grreatly in the times of peace, too, but those won't last long...
Reply to Ulym the Stain's mockery.

Hey you! Are you the Enlightened one? Hahaha! I would rather believe that day and night will swap than that a weakling like you can be the Enlightened! You, kuttas, probably can't even tell the sharp end of a spear from the blunt one!
What are you looking at, kuttas?
Here you are, kuttas. I thought you chickened out!
Defeat Ulym the Stain in the Circle of Equals.

Do you know what the Circle of Equals is, kuttas? It's the place where real hunters like me teach lessons to weaklings like you!

I won't even kill you, I will just chop your tail off, kuttas!

Stop it! I say, stop it!

Ay-hya! What's wrong with you?! Only those warriors who were accepted to the Branch and received the second name can enter the Circle of Equals with the Golases' permission! Off you go, milksops!
Kill 10 Cowardly Jackals and return to Gaal-Svaan in the Khuus Camp.

If you want to compete so much, I will give you a trrial, hunurrs... You think you are real hunters? A real hunter is fast as a lightning and prrecise as a... is very precise! So I'm going to test your swiftness and precision.

There are way too many jackals lurking around the camp. They are cowardly crreatures and flee as soon as they smell danger.

The one who will kill ten jackals before the time runs out, is the real hunter! The one who won't handle it should rather carry a broom instead of a spear and sweep the Circle of Equals, eysh!
Well, kylys, shall I bring you the brroom? Or maybe you will stop staring and go on a hunt finally?
Alright, kylys! The broom goes to Ulym the Stain. I will shave him bald if he trries to escape!
Bring 10 Boar Skins to Gaal-Svaan in the Khuus Camp.

So here's the deal. I should have turned you in to the Golases, but as soon as you are both alive, I will go easy on you.

But still you will have to pay for your foolery, eysh! If you want to kill someone so much, go kill some boars. Flay them and bring their skins to me!
Arrmor made of well-tanned leather will save you from enemy arrows, eysh!
Grreat! I wonder if Alhyz, the Invisible Hunter, is hovering behind your back?
Kill Old Ekhe and bring his head to Gaal-Svaan in the Khuus Camp.

Not every enemy can be defeated single-handedly, young kylys. Your hand has four fingers. If hit a tree with a finger, you will break your finger. If you punch a tree with your fist, you will break the tree. Hunting is just like that. If you hunt a beast on your own, it will kill you. If you take your friends with you, you will return with a trophy.

Old Ekhe has come back to the foothills. I heard him roaring. He's a mighty and spiteful beast, who has killed many arrogant youngsters. Take your friends with you and slay him before he kills someone else!
I heard Old Ekhe rroaring in the mountains. He must be hiding in his den, waiting for the nightfall...

Look at these giant fangs, kylys! Our crrafters will cut a fine necklace out of them!

Here's your reward, eysh!

Ay-hya! Have you come to make fun of me, kuttas? Gaal-Svaan made me sweep the grround as if were a toothless whelp - because of you!

What do you want? Brring it on, and then get lost!
Brring it, kylys, I don't have much time.
Take this small gift, kylys. No hard feelings, right? You are a good hunter!
You are one lucky kylys. Defeating Old Ekhe is a grreat deed!

Are you making fun of me, kuttas? Go on, laugh! Sooner or later I will receive my second name, and it will be either the Slaughterous or the Invincible, eysh!

Oh, who am I fooling?.. I am one unlucky kylys. It takes a lot of pain and effort from me to do things that come so easily to the Enlightened ones like you! It's not fair!

I'm sorry I lost my temper. I thought you would chicken out and rrefuse to enter the Circle. We were both punished for my stupidity.
Obtain 6 measures of honey and bring them to Marina Propagandina at the Empire Embassy.

There is something else you should know. The connection with your Patron grants you the ability to use Runes. The tailless outlanders have brought those Runes to Howlem, and no one knows how they are created. But they can give strength even to a hopeless weakling, eysh!

I don't know much about them, but my tailless frriend will gladly tell you more if you bring her some honey. Her name is Marina Propagandina.

You will find her in the Imperial camp.
Young Pridens are not allowed to speak to Empire citizens without permission of the elderly.

Honey? For me? How sweet! Thank you!

Let me guess: Khuus-Margen has sent you? Huh, the old coon knows how to buy me! This honey is the most tasty thing in the world.

What do you want from me, friend? Pridens cannot be received into the Trinity Church, so the Golas Council decided! Don't ask me to convert you.
Activate your Patron's Rune and talk to Marina Propagandina.

You want to learn how to use Runes? Good!

First you need to learn how to embed Runes. You already have one!

Now activate it. It'll grant you additional powers, because this is a Rune of your Patron. Go on!

It's a simple task, so I'm sure you'll be able to do it, providing that you're not an idiot. Then come back for your reward!
I hope you can do that. It will be a shame if you can't, huh.
Good work, your first lesson is complete. Here's your reward. Visit the Boutique now, and then come back for your next lesson.
Purchase a Rune Welder and use it to combine 2 Runes in your bag, then report to Marina Propagandina.

Runes can be upgraded! You can combine two identical Runes into a more powerful one.

You will need a Rune Welder, Gold Dust, and Crystal Chips. I've rewarded you with the Crystal Chips, Gold Dust, and two Runes of your Patron for our second lesson.

Use your Rune Welder to fuse the two Runes together to create a more powerful one. Don't forget that you can change the amount of consumed Crystal Chips and Gold Dust.
Brilliant! Now you can enhance your Runes. It is a useful knowledge, which I shared with you almost free of charge!
Invite Dool the Cuckoo, Aata the Tassel, and Tohar the Stub to the screening, then report to Ilya Pervukhin.

You are right on time. Today we are going to demonstrate to the people the latest innovation of Imperial culture - the moving story! Ilya Pervukhin, who brought it to Howlem, calls it "Cinema". You have an opportunity to become one of the first spectators!

The screening is about to start, but some of the spectators are still missing. The more Pridens will see the cinema, the better! If it's no bother for you, please invite a couple more friends of yours. They won't be disappointed!
What? Sorry, I'm very busy - I'm setting everything up for the screening. Take a seat in the front row!

Oh... The spectators are here? Shame on me!

I'm sorry, but the cinema is not going to happen!
Aho, kinsman! You want to watch the cinema, too? They say the spectacle is rather imprresive, eysh!
Is it starting already? Ay-hya! I'm on my way!
Are you talking about the rats? Nobody's furry here apart from us and the rats.
Kill 10 Stone Snakes in the Imperial camp and return to Aata the Tassel.

I would love to watch the cinema, eysh! But I prromised to help the tailless get rid of the Stone Snakes that are swarming in this place.

Stone Snakes are almost harmless, but the outlanders are terrified of them. And we were trrained to catch them with our bare hands!

I was promised a good reward for the job, but I can't do it quickly enough on my own. Will you help me? I will share my pay with you!
Just don't be afraid. Snakes bite, but their venom is really weak. Our Trainer uses it as a painkiller!

The outlanders are weird. They have all kinds of interesting things, and they are rready to pay a fortune for them, eysh!

Here is your share, as I prromised. Now let's go watch the cinema!
Light 10 Torches at the Empire Embassy and return to Tohar the Stub.

Aho, kinsman! Do you want to get some extra reward, zoor? The outlanders are generous!

They asked me to light the torrches around the camp. The stupid tailless are afraid of the dark! I told them about hunhurrs, and now they don't even dare to leave the Guarded Cliff.

Ha! The outlanders are scared of hunhurrs, can you believe that? Hunhurrs would run terrified just upon feeling their smell... Just don't tell them that, or they won't pay me. You better help me with the torches so that I can make it on time before the cinema starts, and I will share the reward with you. Alright, zoor?
Hurry up, I prromised to keep the torches lit!
Good job, frriend! Now I can watch the cinema with you. Here's your reward, by the way.
Examine the safe box where the film was stolen from, question the witnesses of the robbery, and find the thief.

Cinema was personally approved by Yasker, the Great Leader of the Empire. "Cinema is the greatest art," he said so himself! So I decided that every inhabitant of Sarnaut has to see it, even in the most distant corners of the world!

Howlem is not the first allod where I come to bring art to the masses, but it's the first one where I face so many difficulties! First, the projector broke, then the screen got torn, then the film was stolen... Can you believe it? Somebody has stolen it right from the locked safe box! Why would anyone need a film with a moving story? You Pridens have no idea how it works!

I am... devastated. I'm humiliated. I promised you the greatest spectacle, and now I can't keep my word! I'm so ashamed!

If only I could find the thief and retrieve the film... I would be extremely grateful if you could help me with that!

Hey there!

Do you want to see our awesome performance, too?
Bring the film back to Ilya Pervukhin at the Empire Embassy and watch the cinema.

What? We didn't steal anything! Pervukhin must have lost it himself... No one but him knew it was in the safe box... Oops! We shouldn't have slipped it out...

We didn't mean to hurt anyone! We wanted to make things fair!

Olly, our younger brother, overdrank the other day and strolled into the Imperial camp. They caught him, beat him up, and took his favorite flask away! Bastards! So Olly decided to get back at them.

We stole the film from the Imperial camp. They didn't notice anything, even though Olly was swine-drunk again.

We just wanted to trade the film for the flask! But they will kill us now if we go there... Can you take the film back, and bring us the flask? Please! We will pay you back! In a good way.
Are you on the trail? Please, hurry up. The audience is waiting!
Here is my film! Thank you so much! I am very grateful!
Watch the cinema, take the flask from Ilya Pervukhin, and bring it to the Nimble Family.

So that was a "joke"? Huh! If Howlem wasn't a neutral zone, I'd catch those Gibberlings and beat the hell out of the three of them! Personally! However, I should return the flask. It's their property, after all...

I will launch the cinema and look for the flask while you are enjoying the greatest of arts!
Oh those Imperial bastards.... They will take away your last shirt!
Yay, you have found the flask! Olly's been so sad without it... Wasn't you, Olly? Look, he can't even speak. Hey, Olly! Have you emptied our flasks, too?!
Obtain a part of the ritual robe by completing Pridens' quests in the Saad Camp, and return to Laan-Ingir.

You must be destined to grreat deeds. The Golases wish to speak to you! Soon the Council will be held at the Temple, where Golases will announce the ones who were accepted to the Branch. They want to see you in one of their Branches, eysh! It's a grreat honor to receive your second name so soon.

Each Priden who is about to enter the Branch has to prepare for the ritual. You will need a special costume, and you have to obtain all the necessary materials by yourself.

Our crafters will help you with that - Saad-Vala, Gaal-Yna, and Khoor-Athin. Don't waste your time, go, eysh!
Hurry up, Golases should see you dressed so beautifully!
This wasn't easy, zoor? Efforts determine the real value of things! Now you know that.
Obtain 10 Lynx' Skins and return to Gaal-Yna in the Saad Camp.

Aho, frriend! Laan-Ingir told me you were coming, and I have sharpened my best needles and prepared my best threads. Your robe will be flawless, I prromise!

The wiseman told me you have to obtain all the necessary materials by yourself, zoor? Excellent!

There is a whole pack of lynxes that settled right outside of our camp. They are dangerous enemies! But their skin will do perfectly for the ritual robe.
I wonder if I can use the fur of these furry outlanders if they die accidentally? It's so soft!
Grreat fur! Many young hunters have died, trying to obtain lynx' fur... But the spirits love you, eysh!
Find Ithyk the Splinter's weapon in the forest near the Saad Camp.

Hush, keep it down! Has he noticed you? Is he somewhere around?

What do you mean, "who?" Haven't you seen it? I'm speaking about that giant beast that almost ate me!

Ah-hya! I was checking on the fowling net, and it just jumped at me from the bushes! A giant lynx!

It scared the hell out of me, eysh! I swear on my ancestors, I'm not afraid of dying, but this beast... I ran like a scared doe when I heard its roar! And now I can't find my weapon. It must have dropped it on the run. Losing your weapon is a great disgrace! But I can't go back and look for it while the father of lynxes is prowling around... Will you help me, zoor?

Oh! I don't even know how to thank you! I am so greatful!

Please, don't tell anyone about my failure. Let the Golases decide how bad my guilt is!
Track the Huge Lynx, lure it to Ithyk the Splinter, and give a sigh to attack.

Kylys! I want to wipe out my disgrace and get the skin of that beast. The Golases will forgive me then!

I can't defeat it on my own, but together we will slay the monster. I will dip my arrow in a deadly poison, and you will lure the beast.

As soon as you are ready, give me a sign, and I will shoot at its heart, eysh! Together we will win!
Don't rush, kylys, a hunter must be patient... Trust me!
Phew... What a beast! The spirits favor us, kylys. This big cat wasn't so scary after all.
Obtain 14 feathers of Cliff Vultures on the Roaring Ridge and return to Khoor-Athin in the Saad Camp.

Aho, kinsman! Do you need a tohtar - a headdress for the Golases' Council? You have come to the right crraftsman!

I will gladly help you, but you will have to obtain the feathers on your own. And you need special ones, eysh!

The Roaring Ridge to the West from here is swarming with dangerous crreatures. Feathers of the Cliff Vultures will make a fine tohtar!
Watch out for you fingers, vultures can bite you!
Nice, smooth feathers. They will make a good tohtar, eysh! The Golases will love it.
Follow the bloody trail, defeat the Hoob Itchy's killer, and return to Laan-Ingir the Gray in the Saad Camp.

Oh... that young Priden was brutally murdered. It looks like somebody's been tearing him with their teeth, but the death was caused by the blunt injury of the head.

The hunter was fighting back desperately, and he must have wounded the killer - the bloody trail leads somewhere up the mountain. If we follow it, we can find the killer... But are we strong enough to defeat him?
Why are you distracting me, kylys?
What do you want, kylys? You smell with blood... Our blood, eysh! What has happened to you?
Ask Laan-Ingir the Gray about tya-ah.

Shoysh! I know... I knew this hunter, may the spirits be merciful to him! His name was Hoob Itchy, and he went to the mountains to obtain feathers for his tohtar, just like you did. You were lucky, eysh! You could have come across a tya-ah!
Ask your question, kylys... Wisdom is the only thing I can share with young hunters like you.
What happened to Hoob is terrible. He was young and brave. May the ancestors' spirits be merciful to him, and may his tyalla be reborn soon in Yao Realm!
Lure several Hydras out of the Crystal Stream using the lance, kill them, obtain 8 fangs, and return to Saad-Vala in the Saad Camp.

Aho, kylys! I've heard about you. You are the Enlightened, right? You will need a special necklace for the Golases' Council!

A common hunter could use a simple pectorale of bones and teeth, but you... I feel the power in you, eysh!

I will make a necklace of Hydras' fangs for you. There is a river to the North from here, called the Crystal Stream. Sly Hydras hide in the sludge at its bottom. Take this lance and poke it at all suspicious humps. Hit the Hydra as soon as it reaches the surface!
Teeth, bones... I need something else! Each hunter has to carry fangs of a predator on their chest, not squrrel's bones!

Excellent fangs, kylys. They will make a beautiful necklace!

Here, trry it on. Very few young hunters can wear such a wonderful thing to the Council!
Kill 12 Fisher-Bears by the upper reaches of the Crystal Stream and return to Utigan the Frogling in the Saad Camp.

Aho, hunter! I see you are used to dealing with dangerous prredators? Personally, I don't like hunting at all... I love fishing! You just look into the water and wait for the slightest movement... And then there's a big shiny fish in your hands!

This is why I was called the Frogling. And your second name must be the Slasher? Of the Daredevil? I can sense something... dangerous about you!

So it must be no trouble for you to defeat a couple of predators, zoor? I wanted to catch some fish for the dinner, but the Fisher-Bears have occupied my spot!
Make a soup, dry it, or fry it? That's a tough choice, eysh!
Are there no more bears? May the spirits grant you their favor, kylys! Stop by from time to time!
Protect Gaal-Irhen while he restores the spells of the Invisible Guardians.

Aho, frriend! They say, the Enlightened always come in time, and now I can see it's true. You've come in time indeed!

I need your help. My Trainer is doolga Gaal-Mysh, the oldest doolga of the Gaal Branch. We, doolgas, are called "the ones who talk with spirits". Only we can see the world that is invisible to others and communicate with the spirits. It's a grreat gift and a big responsibility, eysh!

You see those stone statues? They are called the Invisible Guardians, and they prrotect the Residence from hunhurrs. Not a single crreature can sneak by them unnoticed. I was send to renew their power. Will you help me, kylys?

Ay-hya! Something has gone wrong... Hunhurrs have never dared to approach the Invisible Guardians, let alone to attack a doolga!

I am going to my Trrainer - I need to warn doolgas that the Invisible Guardians don't keep hunhurrs away anymore. I hope we will think of something together. Thank you for your help!
We need to prrotect our lands from hunhurrs. Are you with me, kylys?
Enter the Temple in the Residence and meet the Golases.

You are fast, kylys. Usually young hunters like you spend months trrying to find the best materials for their robe to give a good account of themselves in frront of the Golases. The first Golases' Council is the most important one for most Pridens. Being accepted to a Branch is a grreat obligation that is passed from the ancestors to the next generation...

But don't let me keep you. Go to the Temple in the center of the Residence. The Council is about to begin. Don't let your Trainer down!
What do you want, young kylys? We have nothing to talk about until you join a Branch!
What?! We are under attack? Tya-ah? Are you out of your mind? Tya-ah can't even catch their own tail!
Protect the Keepers while they are carrying the totems to their towers and return to Tyym-Khos.

Hrr... I don't feel the prresence of the Golases! They should have showed up for the Council and expressed their will through the totems... but they are silent! The Primals have spoken, we heard their words. But the Golases remain silent!

We need to hide the totems in the Branches' towers! The power of the Golases is contained in them. If anything happens to them, our people will lose their wisdom!

Enlightened! I'm sorry, but you won't be accepted to the Branch today. The Primals were generous with you, eysh! Help the Keepers! Don't let the enemies reach the totems. I will gather the rest of the warriors in the Residence, and we will tear those tya-ah to pieces!
Don't hesitate, the Enlightened. I can hear the battle from here!
Shoysh... We have barely repelled their attack. I swear on the ancestors, no one could have thought that tya-ah are capable of this!
Are we under attack? We will fight back! The Golases may be silent, but their power is with us!
Are you with us, Enlightened? I hope the Primals have chosen you for a reason!
Teleport to the Empire Embassy and find out who the mysterious sorcerer is.

I've never seen tya-ah being so orrganized. We were attacked by at least five trribes, eysh! This is unbelievable. The savages are constantly fighting each other, even within one trribe. Only an inquisitive and twisted mind could have gathered them and led to assault the Residence!

I keep on thinking about that sorcerer who was with them. Could it be that the outlanders decided to get rid of us by the hands of tya-ah, zoor?

We will set up the defenses, and you go to the Imperial camp. If you find out that the outlanders were behind this, we will hunt them down as wild animals!
Oh, it's you! I was ready to utter my last prayer to the Holy Trinity and die from the hand of a dirty savage!
Use the Teleport to travel to the League Camp and find out if they were behind the tya-ah assault.

Ahem... Why have you attacked us? Our death would likely lead to war between the Empire and Howlem. And it's not hard to guess who would win it!

...

So these aborigines are not Pridens? Hmm... Take no offence, but washed and trimmed, they would look just like you!

Alright, I have no reasons to mistrust you. I don't think you would have killed your kinsman to save a tailless outlander. I swear the Empire has nothing to do with that. Actually, we would like to conclude an alliance with you!

Oh! I saw it for myself: the savages - tya-ah, as you call them - took orders from an elf! A real elf with wings and an arrogant face!

The League must have found out that we were going to offer you an alliance, and decided to strike! You should go to their Embassy, now!

Damn it, it hurts...
This is... unbelievable! We are... humiliated! Devastated! Who will pay for this?!
Bring a bottle of spirits and 10 herbs that grow near the Empire Embassy to Marina Propagandina.

Ahem... That furry sack with bones has injured me badly... I was lucky to kill him before he finished me. Unfortunately, many Imperial soldiers were less lucky...

Our fighters are covered with wounds from the savages' claws. I don't have enough healing abilities to treat everyone, and my medical tent was completely destroyed!

Please, find a bottle of some orcish slop in the camp. It will kill the infection at once! And bring some plantago leaves to stop the bleeding. Meanwhile I will try to save those who have one foot in the Purgatory.
Please, hurry up. I'm exhausted already, and I can't do this on my own!

Thank you very much! Happily, most of the soldiers were wounded less severely as it seemed to me at first, and fifty drops of infusion for inner disinfection will quickly put them back on their feet.

I think I need a sip, too...

Phew! That went down well.
Return to Tyym-Khos the Black in the Residence Temple.

We were rehearsing my new play when those... beasts attacked us! They dashed across the camp and destroyed everything in their way. That was horrible!

They assaulted everyone! We fought back as hard as we could, but there were just too many of them. Many brave soldiers have gone to the Purgatory today. The savages captured those who didn't manage to escape and drove them to the mountains!

I swear I have no idea why they attacked us. All elves that arrived with the Embassy are here... They were here before the assault. I don't know whether the captives are still alive!

Please, find out what happened to them. How? I don't know! Ask your commander!

What took you so long, Enlightened?

Alright, tell us what you've found out?
Collect 20 Breadfruits and meet Gaal-Mysh near the Primal Tree.

So neither the League nor the Empire has anything to do with that, zoor? It's hard to believe that...

No outlanders will leave Howlem before we find out who stirred up the tya-ah! I swear on my ancestors, we will dig out the truth!

The warriors of the Maas Branch have gone chasing after the savages. The rest of the Branches won't interfere - the Maas don't want to share their mission. Let it be so.

I will ask you to go to Yao Realm. Tya of the dead are being purified in its waters before they come back to this world again. The connection with the world of spirits is much strronger near Yao Realm! Doolgas hope that there you will find a way to speak to the Golases. Why are they silent? Are they angry with us?!

Gather some breadfruits as an offering to the spirits, and go to Yao Realm. Gaal-Mysh prromised to meet you by the Primal Tree and tell you about the magical mysteries that a usual warrior like me don't have to know about. I'm not even an Enlightened one...
So you are the Enlightened one? Tyym-Khos speaks highly of you! Honestly, I thought you were older...
Find 6 tool boxes stolen by the tya-ah and return them to Tyym-Tagar in the Residence.

I was robbed! Tya-ah brroke into my house and turned it upside down! The worst thing is, they stole my tools. Shoysh... I'm helpless without them!

I have no idea why would they need them. They can't even light the fire, let alone craft something, eysh!

The tool box is heavy and inedible. Tya-ah prrobably couldn't have even opened it and left it somewhere in the bushes. If you see my tools, please brring them back to me! I will owe you one, eysh!
Stupid tya-ah! They trried to eat a scroll of tanned leather! Look at these teeth marks... I could have made great armor out of it. What are these tatters good for?

My tools! Where have you found them?

Well, it doesn't really matter. Thank you, kinsman! Now I can get back to work. I want to give you something that I have made with my own hands. Choose whatever you want!
Stick totems into the blood-soaked ground to cleanse it from evil and return to Laan-Tumga in the Residence.

They are here... They are whispering, circling, pinching your ears and tail... Can you see them? Do you feel their stinking breath? Do you hear their nasty laugh, zoor? They are waiting for the night to come, and then they will steal your mind!

The grround that has absorbed the blood, is cursed. There, in the depth, in pain and hatred, in suffering and torture of the dead blood, the evil spirits are born. They come at night... They whisper, they hiss and laugh... But I know the way to avoid that and save us all, eysh!

Take these totems. I have carved powerful runes in them. Charged with power and fury of the Primals, the runes will cleanse the evil from the grround! Hurry up before the night falls!
Nightmares are dangerous... They make you vulnerable and helpless, and drrag you into the abyss of despair!
I saw a beautiful drream... The water was flowing by your feet, the haze was wrapping around your shoulders, and the stars where crowning your head. A grreat future is waiting for you, kylys!
Use the magic wand to inscribe the protective signs, defeat the evil spirits, and return to Maas-Margesh in the Residence.

Do you know how to carve in stone? I'm so tired of carving these protective signs!

Tya of the killed tya-ah doesn't go to Yao Realm. Their tyalla remains in our world, filled with pain and hatred. It sprreads illnesses and curses, it spoils water and air, kills animals and brrings bad luck, seeking to take revenge on its murderers.

I need to inscribe the prrotective signs around the Residence to keep the evil out, but I can't do this alone. Will you help me? I need to drraw the signs everywhere I can. They will keep the souls out for some time. Then I will finish with carving them into the stones, and the mischief of tya-ah will never find a way into the Residence!
Stone favors those with a determined character, Enlightened.
Oh... My fingers are bleeding from carving. But now not a single evil spirit will find a way to the Residence! I couldn't have done it without you, kylys. Thank you!
Kill 7 Cobweb Spiders in the Thicket and return to Gaal-Mysh by the Primal Tree.

Something terrible has happened here, Enlightened!

Long ago, there were only bare and lifeless cliffs here. The first doolgas, with the flame of the Primals burning in their hearts, planted a single seed and grew the huge Primal Tree that gave life to the whole forest. The forest is our frriend, it feeds us and prrotects us, and we are grrateful for it. Here, by the roots of the Primal Tree, trappers bring offerings to the spirits!

But now everything is in ruins! Someone broke the altar and scattered the offerings, and the good spirits are gone! The place is swarming with nasty giant spiders. I don't know where they've come from, but if we don't drive them away, the spirits will be angry with us!

Leave the offerings here and kill the cursed spiders. Meanwhile, I will put this place in order!
Drive the spiders away, and I swear on the moon, these lands will be peaceful again.

I knew it! Those were not regular spiders but spawns of darkness that our enemies have sent to kill us!

But how could the enemy get so close to Yao Realm? And who is our enemy? I have no answers, kylys...

I will stay here and try to find out what these spiders are and where the spirits have gone. Go to Yao Realm, Enlightened!

Yao Realm is a sacred place for all Pridens, kylys. After we die, our tya goes here to join the stream that flows to the Great Nothing to wash down all the bad things that we've done. Tyarra dissolves in the water, and new tyalla is born to join the circle of life. But you are the Enlightened, and will resurrect time and time again, until you fulfill your great purpose.

Go to Yao Realm and find my brothers. They don't let evil tyarra leave the waters of Yao. I hope they will help you find out why the Golases are silent, eysh!
Stop! Don't get closer, or I'll kill you!
Kill 10 Demon Bonesnappers on the shore of Yao Realm and return to Khoor-Tyn.

Oh... Sorry, I thought you were one of them...

We were attacked by a swarm of tya-ah several hours ago. They... they killed everyone! I hid in the tree crown and survived by a miracle. I saw them tearing my brothers apart... But the worst thing is, I saw tailless outlanders among them!

They desecrated the lake! The circle of Reincarnation is broken, and now even the Primals can't help us!

All doolgas derive strength through Yao Realm, from the spirits' world. Yao Realm was the door to that world, and now it is closed. The barriers have fallen, evil tyarra has brroken loose, and Demons, our old-time enemies, are sliding in from the Grreat Nothing!

I am helpless without the connection to the spirits' world. But you are the Enlightened! The Light is shining in your heart, eysh! I believe that you can defeat the Demons!
I can't hear the spirits... Our ancestors abandoned us, eysh!
The creatures from the darkness fear you, but they don't give up, eysh! I bet my tail that there are much more of them than it seems... I have a very bad feeling, Enlightened!
Kill the Thick-skinned Demon, pull out the stuck spear, and bring it back to Khoor-Tyn.

We were appealing to Golases when it all happened. When doolga speaks with spirits, his tyarra leaves the body and the realms of this world. We were defenseless before the damned tya-ah. I was late for the beginning of the ritual, and thus survived.

When the tya-ah left, I trried to reach the waters of the Realm, but I was expected. A giant Demon jumped at me from behind a tree. I hit it with my spear, but it got stuck in its thick skin. Then I ran...

My spear must be still sticking out from the side of that monster. If you defeat it, please, brring my spear back. If I am to die in battle with evil tyarra, I want to die as a warrior, with my weapon in my hands, eysh!
I could tear them with my teeth... But I would rather use a spear, since my magical powers are drained!
Thank you, Enlightened. You are giving me hope! No misfortune can break our people down while there are still kylyses like you among us!
Cleanse 5 desecrated totems in Yao Realm, kill 8 hunhurrs, and return to Khoor-Tyn.

The outlanders have desecrated our totems, and black tyarra is leaking to our lands. A hunhurr is the one who returns from the Realm unclean and unreborn. Hunhurrs are pure evil and darkness. We, doolgas, devote our lives to fighting this abomination... But this time we have lost, eysh!

If we don't stop the hunhurrs, nothing will!

The totems crreated by the first disciples of the Primals have always guarded us from the darkness. I believe that the Light in your heart can cleanse them from the filth!
Don't waste time, Enlightened. Only you can cleanse the totems from evil.
I believed in you, Enlightened! The Primals must have seen your future when they were giving you the gift of Light!
Dive into Yao Realm and find what is blocking the way between the world of the living and the spirits' world.

The totems are guarding the Realm from hunhurrs again, but only the Primals know how many of them have already broken in.

And I still can't hear the spirits. It seems as if something is blocking the way between our worlds. There is only one way to see it - to step beyond the Realm!

I am too old to do that. The Realm will entice my tya, it will call it to be reborn... I won't withstand it. Only a young tya, unburdened with sins, can step into the Realm and come back again. You are my only hope, young kylys!
Finally! The shackles are broken, and we can return to the eternal circle of life!
Return to the Residence and ask doolgas or the Trainer if they know anything about the black stone.

An evil will that has broken the eternal circle wants to kill us all... An evil will has deprived the Golases of their voice... An evil will has brought this black stone here, and it has silenced the Golases!

Hurry up, the living one. Go back to your kinsmen. Listen to the words of the wisemen - they know much... The black heart will show the way!
What do you want, Enlightened? Why are you showing me this stone? Talk to doolgas, kylys, I'm a warrior, not a wiseman!
Everything's gone wrong, kylys. We were fooled around like toothless whelps!
Meet Maas-Yarin the Sharp-Eyed in the Maas Camp.

The Maas Branch has sworn to fulfill the blood right and has gone chasing after the tya-ah. No one has thought that the enemy was after the Golases... Now we are paying for our stupidity...

Go to the Maas Camp, kylys. I'm not a prrophet, but believe me - the enemy was not defeated. It is waiting to strrike again, eysh! It won't return to the Residence, it will strike somewhere else, and we need to attack first!
Aho, kinsman! The Maas Branch has sworn to fulfill the blood right, and it will do so! You wish to help us, zoor?
